items.title: John Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: So one of the first people was Teddi King, was a singer. George used her on one album... other people were coming to me, to know, to work with.

ctx.x: I would think that, you know, for managing musicians, you had a really valuable experience doing everything that they do, you know, because now you know what kind of travel they need to have, what kind of arrangements need to be made.

Yeah. It was an excellent position to be in with George Shearing because they came from England and his wife had been handling everything. And they knew nothing about what was happening as far as the business end of it in this country. So it was a valuable experience for me to be able to be in that position but at the time I felt that, well this is just a job, you know, I didn’t think any further than that, until we really got into it and George said to me, “we ought to form a company and, you know, since you’re…
Okay, well we won’t date you with that.
